items.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: That was the year Babe Ruth hit 60 home runs and Lindbergh crossed the Atlantic.

ctx.x: In Brooklyn, yeah. 1927. That was a good year you know. That was the year Babe Ruth hit 60 home runs and Lindbergh crossed the Atlantic. That’s when I started.
And you started on the clarinet. A very good year indeed.
